name: Phosphor Swap
description: A tab swap in the official Phosphor style. One lit boundary travels across the column, the tab you left drains to a dark navy silhouette just ahead of it, and the tab you picked comes back up to full colour just behind it. A rim of brand light rides the boundary with ember sparks drifting into it, and a rose afterglow follows in its wake. Neither window moves, so the column stays exactly where it is.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Direction X
parameters.description: Horizontal part of the direction the boundary travels in. Positive sweeps to the right.

parameters.name: Direction Y
parameters.description: Vertical part of the direction the boundary travels in. Set both parts to get a diagonal sweep. If both are zero the boundary sweeps to the right.

parameters.name: Boundary Softness
parameters.description: How wide the changeover is at the boundary. Small values give a crisp line, large values blend the two tabs over a broad front.

parameters.name: Gate Depth
parameters.description: How far the unlit band reaches on either side of the boundary, as a fraction of the sweep. This is the stretch where the outgoing tab is draining and the incoming one is still coming back up.

parameters.name: Unlit Dim
parameters.description: How dark the band goes. At full strength the content sinks all the way to a navy silhouette, and at zero it keeps its own colour and only the light on the boundary shows.

parameters.name: Glow Intensity
parameters.description: Brightness of the gradient rim on the boundary, the afterglow behind it, and the sparks.

parameters.name: Afterglow
parameters.description: Length of the rose glow trailing in the boundary's wake, over the part of the column that has already changed over.

parameters.name: Ember Sparks
parameters.description: Strength of the small sparks drifting through the unlit band into the boundary.

parameters.name: Ember Density
parameters.description: How many lanes of ember sparks feed the boundary. More lanes also means smaller sparks, since each one is sized to its lane.

parameters.name: Boundary Meander
parameters.description: How raggedly the boundary wavers as it travels. Zero gives a straight edge.

parameters.name: Meander Grain
parameters.description: Scale of the waver along the boundary. Higher values give finer ripples.
